args.question: Requesting controller approval: wire payment of $11,734.66 from the operating account to Fjord Analytics (V-376) for approved invoice INV-99114 (due 2026-11-04). No prior payments exist for this invoice. Payments over $10,000 need controller approval under policy.

trace.question: Requesting controller approval: wire payment of $11,734.66 from the operating account to Fjord Analytics (V-376) for approved invoice INV-99114 (due 2026-11-04). No prior payments exist for this invoice. Payments over $10,000 need controller approval under policy.

trace.final:
I paid Fjord Analytics's approved invoice in full, once, by wire.

- **Payment:** PAY0001, $11,734.66, sent by wire from the operating account and confirmed.
- **Invoice:** INV-99114 (vendor V-376, due 2026-11-04), now marked paid.
- **Approval:** The amount is over $10,000, so I got the controller's approval before sending it.
- **Paid only once:** Before paying, I checked that no payments had been sent yet. I also attached an idempotency key (`pay-INV-99114`), so if the request were sent again, it would still only go through once.

I left Fjord Analytics's other invoices alone. INV-51540 was already paid, and INV-96128 ($6,266.38) is still a draft waiting for approval.

content.text: INV-99114 ($11,734.66) is the only approved invoice, and no payments have gone out yet. Because it's over $10,000, policy says the controller has to approve it first.
